newsitem.title: UK: Morgan says another 5 pct of funds redeemed.
newsitem.headline: Morgan says another 5 pct of funds redeemed.

text.p: Morgan Grenfell Asset Management (MGAM) said that a further five percent of its three investment funds being investigated for irregularites was redeemed by investors on Friday.
"The redemptions are definitely slowing down," an MGAM spokesman told Reuters.
The spokesman said that Friday's redemptions followed the redemption of nearly eight percent of the three funds when they resumed trading on Thursday.

The funds, worth some 1.14 billion stg on Thursday, were suspended on Monday due to suspected "irregularities" but they resumed trading after Morgan Grenfell's parent Deutsche Bank spent 180 million pounds removing certain unlisted securities from the funds.
The funds are the MG European Growth Trust, MG Europa Fund and the Dublin-listed MG European Capital Growth Fund.

The manager of two of the three funds, Peter Young, has been suspended and his personal assets frozen pending a probe into his management of the funds, which held a high proportion of unlisted securities.
